SELECT p.sku, p.name, p.reorder_point, COALESCE(SUM(s.on_hand), 0) AS existencias_totales
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.sku = p.sku
GROUP BY p.sku, p.name, p.reorder_point
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.on_hand), 0) < p.reorder_point
ORDER BY p.sku

SELECT DISTINCT p.sku, p.name, p.category, p.reorder_point, s.name AS supplier_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, w.city, st.on_hand
FROM products p
JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
JOIN stock st ON st.sku = p.sku
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = st.warehouse_id
WHERE p.critical = TRUE
  AND s.country = 'DE'
  AND st.on_hand < p.reorder_point
ORDER BY p.sku, w.name
